QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: modelPath
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Path to the GGUF model file used for AI inference.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Model Path

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: gpuLayers
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Number of model layers to offload to GPU. Set to 0 for CPU-only inference.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: GPU Layers

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: contextLength
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Context window size in tokens. Larger values use more memory.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Context Length

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: threadCount
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Number of threads for inference. 0 means auto-detect based on CPU cores.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Thread Count

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: temperature
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Sampling temperature. Higher values produce more random output. Range: 0.0 to 2.0.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Temperature

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: topP
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Top-p (nucleus) sampling threshold. Lower values focus on more likely tokens. Range: 0.0 to 1.0.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Top P

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: autoApproveSafe
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Automatically approve non-flight-critical tool actions without user confirmation. Only enable in trusted environments.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Auto-approve Safe Actions
